settings.heading: Personalized pens and desk signs
settings.intro: Engrave a presentation pen or design a desk sign online, check every letter in a live preview, and order a piece that looks like it was made for one person — because it was.
settings.pen_text: A black rollerball pen in a lined presentation case. Engrave the cap with a name and personalize the metal band on the case, then watch both update as you type.
settings.sign_heading: Design a desk sign or name plate
settings.sign_text: Choose acrylic, piano-finished rosewood, or a classic plate, then set the size, finish, and wording. Pricing and shipping update live as you build the order.
settings.shop_text: Prefer to start from a finished style? Browse our desk signs, name plates, and office nameplates below.
